status: registered before the first materialization run
purpose: Verify genuine APEX import, runtime, three fixed tasks and Oracle selection. This is not a comparison of search algorithms.
variation: One Oracle-owned binary trait mutation of the surviving baseline
selection: An eligible challenger survives only if its measured Oracle score strictly exceeds the incumbent. Ties retain the incumbent.
performance: Median of three warm authenticated page loads with equivalent reset fixtures
limitations: One seed and one advance cannot establish evolutionary or AI superiority.
Automated task effort and timing are engineering proxies, not a human usability study.
Only compiler-verified classic-report and separate-page edit mappings may be imported.
A failed import consumes its reservation and cannot be retried for the same organism.
Source, evaluator, fixtures and compiler fingerprints must be retained with every outcome.
